kpis.description_fr: Valeur juste portefeuille immobilier (santé / résidences seniors EU). Hero KPI REIT, base actifs structurels.
kpis.description_en: Fair value real estate portfolio (healthcare / senior housing EU). REIT hero KPI, structural asset base.

kpis.description_fr: EPRA earnings par action : KPI normalisé REITs, indicateur revenu opérationnel récurrent.
kpis.description_en: EPRA earnings per share: normalized REIT KPI, recurring operating income indicator.

kpis.description_fr: Taux d'occupation portefeuille. KPI structurel REIT, ~100% sur senior care car contrats triple net long terme.
kpis.description_en: Portfolio occupancy rate. Structural REIT KPI, ~100% on senior care due to long-term triple-net leases.

kpis.description_fr: WALT (Weighted Average Lease Term) : durée moyenne pondérée baux restants. >15 ans = très long terme typique senior care.
kpis.description_en: WALT (Weighted Average Lease Term): weighted average remaining lease term. >15 years = very long-term, typical senior care.

kpis.description_fr: LTV (Loan-to-Value) : dette nette / valeur portefeuille. Cible REIT <45%, indicateur risque financement.
kpis.description_en: LTV (Loan-to-Value): net debt / portfolio value. REIT target <45%, financing risk indicator.

kpis_story.description_fr: Demande senior housing EU/UK structurellement positive 2024-2030 (boomers 80+). Aedifica positionnée pure-play, expansion développement multi-pays. Capex 2025 ciblé €400M.
kpis_story.description_en: EU/UK senior housing demand structurally positive 2024-2030 (80+ boomers). Aedifica positioned as pure-play, multi-country development expansion. 2025 capex targeted €400M.
